test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, “NOPE” is coded as “100”, and “EGG” is coded as “38”. How will “LAP” be coded in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15de3128e581b71e1c2b4443913576e7f6ece2eda64ec5f300508174745e0fb9.png] 

The pattern followed by the given codes is:

** Sum of positional values of the alphabets × 2 = Code**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/694214a4a5fa663e78985e8bdc496de38c46b55277b0a70b2db3a2f2a7610f13.png] 50 × 2 = 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e63db1a0af2d6a547365a06c641862c50cd1ff2ac5e5296fcb781ac71114993f.png] 19 × 2 = 38 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea1fd84c4a9e6dc3d41e2f1adedf50e4ded390aa8d7642206ca93dd9c87b51a7.png] 29 × 2 = 58

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
